item.title: Wynn Donates MOP 5 Million to Aid Disaster Relief in Xizang
item.description:
>
Wynn Donates MOP 5 Million to Aid Disaster Relief in Xizang Wynn Macau Limited announced today (4 September) that it will donate MOP 5 million to Gyirong County in Xigaze, Xizang Autonomous Region, through the assistance of the Liaison Office of the Central People’s Government in the Macao SAR to support emergency response and post-disaster reconstruction work after the region was recently hit by severe mudslides that resulted in heavy casualties and property damage.   Linda Chen, President, Vice Chairman of the Board, and Executive Director of Wynn Macau Limited, stated that Wynn has always supported national development. She expressed deep sadness over the casualties and property losses caused by the mudslide disaster and extended her sincere condolences to the affected residents and families. She hopes that this donation will contribute to the local relief and rebuilding efforts, helping the affected residents overcome the hardship, while paying tribute to all frontline emergency workers. Wynn sincerely wishes for the smooth progress of all rescue and recovery work in the disaster region, and hopes that those affected can rebuild their homes and resume their normal lives as soon as possible.

item.title: SJM Resorts Donates MOP 5 Million to Support Disaster Relief and Reconstruction in Gyirong County
item.description:
>
SJM Resorts Donates MOP 5 Million to Support Disaster Relief and Reconstruction in Gyirong County SJM Resorts has announced a donation of MOP 5 million through the Liaison Office of the Central People’s Government in the Macao SAR to support disaster relief efforts in Gyirong County in Xigaze, Xizang Autonomous Region, which was recently struck by severe mudslides. Expressing profound concern over the disaster, SJM Resorts actively responded to the call of the Macao SAR Government and announced the donation. The funds will support local emergency rescue operations, the resettlement of affected residents, and post-disaster reconstruction, extending the care and support of the Macao community to the disaster-stricken area. Ms. Daisy Ho, Managing Director of SJM Resorts, stated that as a patriotic enterprise rooted in Macao for over 60 years, SJM Resorts has always remained attentive to national development and social needs. Through this donation, SJM Resorts hopes to send care and support to the affected area, convey heartfelt sympathies to the victims, and pay high tribute to all frontline personnel involved in the rescue efforts. She sincerely wishes that those affected will overcome the difficulties soon and resume their normal lives.

item.title: 美高梅中國捐500萬 支援西藏吉隆救災善後
item.description:
>
美高梅捐500萬澳門元助西藏吉隆賑災。 西藏自治區日喀則市吉隆縣上月遭受嚴重泥石流災害，災情嚴峻，當地民眾生命財產安全遭受重大損失。為向受災同胞表達關切和支援，美高梅中國今日(4日)宣佈，透過澳門中聯辦向西藏自治區捐出500萬澳門元，以支持當地的緊急救災及善後恢復工作，冀助災區及民眾重建家園。 美高梅中國董事長及執行董事何超瓊表示，山川相連，風雨同舟。美高梅與受災同胞血濃於水，心繫一起，時刻關注災情，藉着這片心意向遇難者致以沉痛哀悼，向遇難者與失聯者家屬、受災民眾致以深切慰問，同時向全力投入搶險救援工作的前線人員致以崇高敬意；相信在中央政府和西藏自治區政府的領導下，災區人民定能走出難關，逐步恢復正常生活。

item.title: Melco Donates MOP 5 Million to Support Disaster Relief and Reconstruction Efforts in Gyirong County, Xizang
item.description:
>
Melco Donates MOP 5 Million to Support Disaster Relief and Reconstruction Efforts in Gyirong County, Xizang Melco Resorts & Entertainment Limited announced today (4th) that, with the full assistance of the Liaison Office of the Central People’s Government in the Macao Special Administrative Region, it has donated MOP 5 million to support disaster relief and post-disaster reconstruction in Gyirong County, Xigaze, Xizang Autonomous Region, following recent mudslides.   The mudslides severely impacted the Gyirong Port area, causing road blockages, damage to homes and infrastructure, as well as significant casualties and missing persons. The donation will be utilized to supply and distribute emergency relief materials, provide temporary shelter and medical aid for displaced residents, and assist affected families in rebuilding their homes and restoring normal life as quickly as possible.   Mr. Lawrence Ho, Chairman and CEO of Melco, stated that all colleagues are deeply saddened by the severe casualties caused by this natural disaster. He expressed heartfelt sympathy for the families of the victims, the missing, and the disaster-stricken residents, while offering condolences and encouragement to the frontline rescue teams. As a company rooted in Macao, Melco has long remained committed to corporate social responsibility. Through this contribution, the company hopes to extend practical support to the people of Gyirong County and will continue to follow the area’s reconstruction progress, wishing the affected residents a swift recovery and rebuild of their homes.

item.title: Modified Clothing Used to Hide Phones for Baccarat Live Stream Betting: Judiciary Police Arrested Three Men and Seizes 220,000 in Cash and Chips
item.description:
>
Modified Clothing Used to Hide Phones for Baccarat Live Stream Betting: Judiciary Police Arrested Three Men and Seizes 220,000 in Cash and Chips Macau busted an illegal proxy betting operation at a casino in Cotai early Tuesday (September 1), arresting a Macau resident and two mainland men. The suspects allegedly used modified clothing to conceal mobile phones, illegally filming and live-streaming baccarat tables to allow mainland gamblers to place bets remotely. The operation resulted in the seizure of cash and chips valued at 220,000 Hong Kong dollars, alongside various tools used in the crime.   The arrested individuals include a 43-year-old local businessman named Lao, as well as two unemployed mainland men, a 37-year-old named Guo and a 29-year-old named Qiao. Upon receiving a report early Tuesday morning, Judiciary Police officers rushed to the scene and intercepted the three suspects while they were actively operating at a baccarat table.   According to the investigation, two of the suspects wore modified tops outfitted with hidden pockets and small holes to fix mobile phones to their chests. They covertly filmed the gaming table and transmitted the live feed to mainland clients via streaming software, receiving betting instructions through miniature Bluetooth earpieces while the third suspect recorded the wins and losses nearby. Driven by the desire to earn extra income, Qiao claimed he was promised 300 RMB in compensation, Guo had accumulated 2,500 RMB in profits since operating in August, and Lao’s exact illicit earnings remain under investigation.   Police seized several mobile phones, Wi-Fi routers, miniature earpieces, and modified clothing from the three suspects. The case has been transferred to the Public Prosecutions Office for further investigation, with the suspects facing charges related to the illegal operation of online games of chance or online mutual betting.

item.title: 金沙中國捐出1000萬 支援西藏吉隆救災工作
item.description:
>
金沙中國捐出1000萬元，支援西藏吉隆救災工作。 西藏自治區日喀則市吉隆縣日前遭受泥石流災害，造成重大人員傷亡，災情嚴峻。金沙中國今天(4日)宣佈，將透過澳門中聯辦的全力協助，向西藏自治區捐出1,000萬澳門元，以實際行動支援災區救援及重建工作，並將澳門同胞的關愛與牽掛送往災區，為當地居民送上支持與力量。 金沙中國行政副主席王英偉表示，金沙中國心繫祖國，對災害帶來的重大傷亡與損失深感痛惜，向遇難者致哀、慰問受災同胞。金沙中國將透過捐款支援災區救援、民眾安置及災後重建，盼助災民渡過難關，堅信災區定能戰勝困境、重建家園。

item.title: GEG and Lui Che Woo Family Charitable Foundation Donate MOP10 Million to Support Relief and Recovery Efforts in Xizang
item.description:
>
GEG and Lui Che Woo Family Charitable Foundation Donate MOP10 Million to Support Relief and Recovery Efforts in Xizang To support emergency relief efforts and accelerate post-disaster recovery in the mudslide-affected areas of Gyirong County, Xigaze, Xizang Autonomous Region, Galaxy Entertainment Group (GEG) announced on Thursday (September 3) that, with the full assistance of the Liaison Office of the Central People’s Government in the Macao Special Administrative Region, GEG and Lui Che Woo Family Charitable Foundation will jointly donate MOP10 million. The donation will be used exclusively to support emergency search and rescue operations, relief supplies, temporary resettlement of affected residents, medical assistance, and subsequent disaster reconstruction and recovery efforts in the affected communities.   A severe mudslide recently struck Gyirong Port in Gyirong County, Xigaze, Xizang Autonomous Region. This sudden natural disaster caused extensive damage to local transportation networks, infrastructure, and residents’ livelihoods, as well as significant casualties and property losses, drawing widespread concern across the nation.   Mr. Francis Lui, Chairman of GEG, expressed his deep concern for the affected compatriots, his profound sadness over the devastating mudslide in Gyirong County, his sincere sympathies to the affected residents, and his highest respect to all frontline rescue personnel. He stated that in the face of such a severe natural disaster, all sectors of society swiftly joined hands to offer aid, rapidly pooling significant support and fully demonstrating the Chinese nation’s enduring tradition and spirit of unity, mutual assistance, and shared resilience in times of adversity. Mr. Lui added that as a patriotic enterprise rooted in Macau, GEG remains committed to fulfilling its social responsibilities and responding actively to the Macau SAR Government’s call for support. GEG hopes this donation will provide timely and meaningful assistance to frontline relief efforts, helping affected compatriots overcome current challenges and heal the trauma caused by the disaster.   GEG and Lui Che Woo Family Charitable Foundation have long remained attentive to the country’s social needs and steadfast in upholding the principle that “what is taken from the community is to be used for the good of the community” by supporting and participating in charitable causes and disaster relief initiatives. GEG and Lui Che Woo Family Charitable Foundation extend their highest respect to all medical personnel, firefighters, rescue workers, and volunteers serving on the frontlines. They sincerely hope that, under the joint efforts and care of the Central Government, the Xizang Autonomous Regional Government, and all sectors of society, affected residents will overcome current difficulties, smoothly carry out home reconstruction, and restore normal life and production orders as soon as possible.

item.title: Wynn Launches 20th Anniversary Share Award to Express Gratitude to Team Members and Share Success
item.description:
>
Wynn Launches 20th Anniversary Share Award to Express Gratitude to Team Members and Share Success Wynn Macau, Limited (1128) has announced the launch of a one-time “Wynn Macau 20th Anniversary Share Award”, under which eligible team members of Wynn Macau and Wynn Palace will be granted shares in Wynn Macau, Limited. Through this initiative, Wynn aims to extend appreciation to team members for their outstanding contributions over the years and share the company’s success. Nearly 95% of the company’s current full-time workforce of 11,660 will benefit from this initiative, reflecting Wynn’s commitment to recognizing and rewarding talent while encouraging team members to grow alongside the company and create long-term value together.   Ms. Linda Chen, President, Vice Chairman, and Executive Director of Wynn Macau, Limited, stated in her speech at the anniversary event that Wynn Macau’s achievements over the past two decades would not have been possible without the Central Government’s support for Macao through its various policies and the strong support of the Macao SAR Government. She also expressed her deep gratitude to the Wynn Macau team members and their families for working side by side with her over the past 20 years to drive the company’s continuous growth. She commended team members for being united by a shared sense of purpose and aspiration, dedicating themselves to showcasing Macao’s renowned hospitality and exceptional service to guests from around the world, while actively giving back to the community and continuing to contribute to Macao’s development and well-being.   More than 1,400 day-one team members have remained with the company since the opening of Wynn Macau in 2006. They gathered at the anniversary event to look back on the cherished journey of working alongside the company and Macao over the past two decades. Wynn Macau paid tribute to their 20 years of dedicated service, presenting each eligible day-one team member with a 20-year service certificate and a Wynn 20th Anniversary Share Award valued at MOP 50,000. Looking ahead, Wynn and its team members will continue to uphold the shared vision of “Two Decades of Shared Success, Committed to Partnership for a Sustainable Future”, further strengthening their commitment to Macao and working together for a brighter future.

item.title: 澳娛綜合捐款500萬 支援西藏災區救援重建
item.description:
>
澳娛綜合捐款500萬澳門元，支援吉隆縣救災重建。 西藏自治區日喀則市吉隆縣近日遭受嚴重泥石流災害，災區同胞的安危與生活情況牽動社會各界的心。澳娛綜合對災情深表關切，並積極響應澳門政府的呼籲，今日(4日)宣佈透過澳門中聯辦捐出500萬澳門元，支援當地緊急救援、受災群眾安置及災後重建工作，為災區送上澳門社會的一份關懷與支持。 澳娛綜合常務董事何超鳳表示，作為植根澳門60多年的愛國愛澳企業，澳娛綜合一直關注國家發展和社會需要。澳娛綜合希望透過是次捐款，向災區送上關懷與支持，向受災同胞致以誠摯慰問，並向所有參與救援工作的前線人員致以崇高敬意，衷心祝願災民早日渡過難關，恢復安定生活。

item.title: 永利澳門捐款500萬 助西藏吉隆應急救援災後重建
item.description:
>
永利捐款500萬澳門元助西藏吉隆救災重建。 西藏自治區日喀則市吉隆縣近日發生嚴重泥石流災害，造成重大人員傷亡及財產損失，災情牽動社會各界。永利澳門今日(4日)宣佈，將透過澳門中聯辦協助向災區捐款500萬澳門元，用以支援應急救援、受災群眾安置及災後重建工作。 永利澳門總裁、董事會副主席兼執行董事陳志玲表示，永利始終與國家發展同心同行。她對此次泥石流災害造成的人員傷亡及財產損失深感痛心，並向受災居民及受影響家庭致以誠摯慰問；希望透過是次捐款，為災區救援及重建工作略盡綿力，協助受災群眾渡過難關，並向所有奮戰在救援一線的人員致以崇高敬意。 永利衷心祝願災區各項救援和恢復工作順利推進，受災群眾早日重建家園，恢復正常生活秩序。
